headline: Denmark accuses Russia of plot to kill Ukrainian-American rapper
pages: Denmark accused Russian intelligence on Friday of planning an attempt to assassinate a Ukrainian-American near Copenhagen. Danish media named the target as rapper Kyivstoner, whose real name is Albert Vasiliev. Denmark's security agency PET said it stopped three people in a car near a music venue on Sept. 25, and found firearms and knives. It linked them to a banned gang, Loyal to Familia. Two people are charged with attempted murder and assisting a foreign intelligence service, and have pleaded not guilty. Foreign Minister Lars Lokke Rasmussen said Russia's defence attache must leave within seven days. Russia's embassy called the claims unsubstantiated.
Denmark also wants the EU to tighten Schengen visa rules for Russians. Source: BBC
